verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents multiple scheduling links, per-link rules, and per-link conferencing locations such as Zoom, Meet and Whereby. Custom booking questions are only implied, by workflow templates that can insert guests' answers. The closest thing to a confirmation rule is payment-gated booking. Missing for 10: explicit per-link duration settings, documented custom-question configuration, confirmation/approval rules (e.g., manual approval of requests), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer multiple event types with their own durations, locations, custom questions, and confirmation rules

citations.quote: Very easy to make multiple calendar links
Set a few rules on each link, and SavvyCal keeps your schedule sane.

Automatically create unique Zoom rooms for new events.
or their answers to your booking questions.
Clients pay as they book, and the meeting only lands on your calendar once the payment goes through.
